title: Space-tech landing page
brief: The landing page for PERIGEE, a fictional orbital-logistics company offering rideshare launches plus last-mile orbital transfer vehicles. Hero with a thin-line engineering rocket rendering (pure SVG/CSS, no stock photos), live-feeling mission counters and a ticking T-minus clock, a vehicles section with drawn spec sheets, a launch-manifest timeline, a working payload-price estimator as the 'fly with us' CTA, a careers strip and a footer. Scroll animations tasteful, transform-only and reduced-motion aware.
da: Aerospace flagship: near-black, Saira expanded-vs-condensed grotesk contrast, engineering-blueprint hairlines, one pure signal-orange accent (#FF6A00), Swiss negative space.
